opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger of imprisonment, injury or death. Works with a network of 135 universities and research institutes to find temporary refuge where fellows can continue their work, providing 2- or 3-year awards as standard, additional funding, help with visa processes and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members. Most placements are in the UK.
